note: DSFR registry epistemic record. See _base/findings-ledger.md. Backfilled from 2026-09-29/30 sessions; earlier evidence lives in the project workspace (workspace/docs/lessons-learned.md).

changed: registry: verification mechanism added (@gouvfr/dsfr 1.15.3 exact pin, two stylesheets, classCheck with 7 documented drift entries)
findings.summary: Five tiles used structure absent from DSFR 1.15, and the pin was an unverifiable minor range.
findings.detail: The registry was pinned to "1.15" — stated but not checkable. Installing @gouvfr/dsfr at the exact patch made the drift enumerable: fr-card__link, fr-card__media, fr-responsive-img-wrapper, fr-download__name/__meta, fr-summary__list and fr-btn--disabled do not exist in 1.15.3. The tile family also predates the icons-in-utility-bundle discovery, which would have made icon tiles false-positives under a core-only check.

changed: registry: 11 tiles corrected against the current templates (fr-enlarge-link on the card root, bare link in fr-card__title, fr-card__header>fr-card__img>fr-responsive-img, bare <ol> in summary, disabled attribute on the button)
registry: reworked tiles relabeled origin: design-system
findings.summary: Eleven pre-1.15 tiles corrected; fixing card/default cleared drift inherited by the six cloned card variants.
findings.detail: A mechanical finding worth recording: the six card variants were cloned from card/default before its drift was known, so they inherited fr-card__link. Drift propagates through cloned variant tiles — a base-tile fix silently fixes its whole family, and the drift register has to say so or the allowlist lies about how many tiles are affected.

changed: registry: 15 canon variant tiles added (card horizontal/half/tier/sm/shadow/no-border/download, 5 tag colours + sm, callout--brown-caramel, radio rich)
registry: 3 new families added (tile, modal, search-bar)
evidence: impots.gouv.fr (135 fr- families — richest site surveyed), culture.gouv.fr (76), agriculture.gouv.fr (58), service-public.fr (68)
findings.summary: A field survey of French ministry sites found 3 missing families and a documented variant range the registry covered only in part.
findings.detail: Every candidate was verified against the pinned CSS before a tile was written, which rejected three: fr-card--big, fr-card--une and fr-notation. The last is absent from 1.15.0 through 1.15.3 (latest) — a site-local rating component on culture.gouv.fr, recorded as an extension rather than a component.

changed: tile: download/default labeled a live-site observation of a deprecated component, stamp withdrawn
registry: 60/61 tiles verified; the one unstamped tile has a documented reason
findings.summary: The DSFR download component is deprecated upstream, so its tile cannot be corrected against a live component.
findings.detail: Recorded rather than removed: retiring a family is a maintainer decision. The tile stays as a labelled live-site observation with its pre-1.15 classes intact, and carries no version stamp because there is nothing in the pin to verify it against.
